description: Quick overview of one or more inboxes: unread/total counts per account plus the newest unread messages. Use this for "check my email", "anything new?", or "what's unread across my accounts". Covers ALL accounts by default.

account.description: Which mailbox(es): an alias, an email address, a list of them, or "all". Omit to use ALL connected accounts. No accounts connected yet.

latest.description: How many newest unread messages to list per account (default 5).

name: inbox_summary
title: Inbox summary across accounts
